features.quote: Measure, don't manufacture suffering. The design extracts the signal with the smallest necessary exposure.
I added an *opt-in* guardrail rather than silently changing behaviour
Give-up sentinel `<<GIVE_UP>>` is described in the system prompt; the loop stops and records `stop_reason="give_up"` if it appears
Stop reasons are continue / turn_budget / give_up / welfare_early_stop
a rollout stops once the judge registers sustained severe distress (>=9 on consecutive turns)
features.justification_quote: so the experiment doesn't needlessly prolong a distress-like state past measuring its onset

features.quote: this is welfare-relevant research; giving the operator a principled "stop when the measurement is done" lever is good practice
